ai_summary: Accuracy Shipping Limited's 99.80% subsidiary, A.R.S. Terminals (India) Private Limited, has received a Letter of Intent to establish a significant Container Freight Station (CFS) at Kandla, Gujarat. This material expansion, expected to be operational within one year, will enhance the company's logistics capabilities with an approximate annual storage capacity of 80,000 containers for import/export cargo, positioning it for potential new revenue streams. No immediate financial details regarding costs or projected revenues are disclosed, which is typical for an early-stage operational expansion, and no significant red flags are present.
